name: Kbd
description: Keyboard keys and shortcuts, shown with the symbols or the words of the reader's platform.

props.name: children
props.description: The key's label, such as Esc, ⌘ or K.

props.name: variant
props.description: Keycap has an outline and a heavier lower edge so it reads as a key. Flat is a muted fill with no border. Inverse is for ink surfaces such as tooltips.

props.name: isPressed
props.description: Shows the key held down: it drops a pixel, the lower edge flattens and the label darkens.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every attribute of a kbd element.

props.name: keys
props.description: Keys joined with +, such as "mod+shift+p". mod is ⌘ on Apple systems and Ctrl elsewhere. Also understands ctrl, alt (or option), shift, meta, enter, esc, tab, backspace, delete, space, the arrows (arrowup or up), home, end, pageup, pagedown, F1 to F12 and any single character.

props.name: separator
props.description: Shown between keys. By default nothing on Apple systems, where the keys sit close together, and a muted + elsewhere. Pass null to remove it everywhere.

props.name: listen
props.description: Listens to the keyboard: each key goes down while it is held, and the combo flashes a water ring once when all of it is pressed together. Key repeat is ignored.

props.name: platform
props.description: Which names to show. Auto reads the platform after hydration and renders the Apple symbols on the server.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the outer kbd element. Also accepts its other attributes.
